Texts.Chs: 在^orange;采集工作台^reset;处制造^orange;灯笼杆^reset;并带给^green;韦尔奇^reset;
Texts.Eng: Craft a ^green;Lantern Stick^reset; at the ^orange;Foraging Table^reset; and return to ^green;Welchie^reset;.
Now you'll be able to slap that on your back and travel without needing to hold a flashlight! Also, I found some ^orange;Plant Fibre^reset; in storage. Why don't you take it?

Texts.Chs: 有时，黑暗会成为一种可怕的障碍。那是个^orange;充满油^reset;的地方。我让你来做：你可以做一个^orange;灯笼杆^reset;在黑暗中看^orange;采集工作台^reset;学习如何^green;研究^reset;^orange;农业^reset;。
Texts.Eng: Sometimes, the darkness can prove a horrible hindrance. That's where tha ^orange;Oil^reset; I got ya ter make comes in: You can craft a ^orange;Lantern Stick^reset; to see in the dark at a ^orange;Foraging Table^reset;. ^green;Research^reset; into ^orange;Agriculture^reset; to learn how.
